title: FoxMica
description:
A 3 mode theme with less padding all the way around.
Meant to blend in with WinUI and Windows Explorer Styled in [Micabar from Windhawk](https://github.com/ramensoftware/windows-11-file-explorer-styling-guide/blob/main/Themes/MicaBar/README.md). Built on [FoxOne by Firnschnee](https://github.com/firnschnee/foxone). StockMica+ supports [PWAsForFirefox](https://github.com/filips123/PWAsForFirefox)
